notes: DECISION: the same API now has two brands. In Sweden the product was renamed Spiris (its API docs are 'Spiris/eAccounting API Documentation', and the current PNG is that docs header's white 'Spiris | VISMA' wordmark); elsewhere (e.g. the Netherlands) it is 'eAccounting by Visma' with this red leaf. I shipped the leaf because the integration is named Visma eAccounting. If the reviewer prefers Spiris, its app icon exists as a real SVG: https://assets.spiris.se/favicons/safari-pinned-tab.svg (kept at downloads/visma-eaccounting/src5/safari-pinned-tab.svg; coral #FF5E57 rounded tile with a black S, two paths, not a trace, identical to spiris.se's apple-touch-icon), usable as-is (tile, no padding). The leaf's palest pink tip is faint on white (lost_light 0.04), which is how the brand draws it.
